$comment: The world-scale terrain (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.3, docs/WORLD_GENERATION.md, ADR 0049, ADR 0074). Heights in metres above sea level, distances in metres. `inland` is the land's rise away from the coast, part of the base height field the world map samples on its 100 m grid before the uplift layer and the erosion (shared/worldgen/hydrology.json); `spawn` where players start; `defaultBiome` the biome (shared/worldgen/biomes/*.json, by name) that shapes the rest: its sea floor, hills, bumps, detail, rivers, mouths, lakes and surface bands. Prototype content (§6.1). Changing any value changes the terrain a seed generates: regenerate the goldens (`cargo run -p dwell-worldgen --example goldens`) and ship it on a new compatibility line. Run `node shared/worldgen/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails on stale output.

spawn.$comment: Players spawn on level dry land between minHeight and maxHeight m above sea level, preferring a river within nearRiver m: the map's cells are ranked by their distance from the disc's centre (the land nearest it first), and the first that suits is searched for a level patch.
